```mermaid
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

- **PR #**: 357
- **URL**: https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/pull/357
- **Title**: gh-346 parity: Confluence REST v2 support (CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-346` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +645
- **Deletions**: -99
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:22:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-346` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +645
- **Deletions**: -99
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:22:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 357
- **URL**: https://github.com/epam/dmtools-dart/pull/357
- **Title**: gh-346 parity: Confluence REST v2 support (CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-346` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +645
- **Deletions**: -99
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:22:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

```mermaid
flowchart TD

  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. - **State**: open

- **Additions**: +645
- **Deletions**: -99
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T14:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T14:22:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. ### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

Under v2, `_titleAndSpaceResponse` throws `StateError` when the space key cannot be resolved:

```dart
final spaceId = _spaceIdFromKey(config, space);
```

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

```mermaid
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```

## PR Description

Closes #346
### What changed
Completed the Confluence REST v2 parity port (gh-346) in the sync tool layer (`ConfluenceSyncTools` and its page-ops/attachments/downloader collaborators): create/update, title lookup, and attachment listing now route to `/wiki/api/v2` under `CONFLUENCE_API_VERSION=v2`, matching Java commits 8ab83733 / 5abd3612 / be01b1e8. The async `ConfluenceClient` already had this routing; only the sync (`executeToolViaJava`) path was missing it.

### Key decisions
- `spaceIdFromKey` resolves the space key via `GET /wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys=`; unknown keys surface the Java `IOException` message (`Confluence space not found by key: …`) as a sync error / `StateError`.
- v2 create/update payloads mirror the async client: `spaceId` + explicit `status: current` + `body.value`; `parentId` omitted when empty (v2 API 400s on it); updates drop `ancestors`/`space` and carry the bumped `version.number` + history message.
- CQL search and the multipart upload stay v1 (Java #592 documented limitation — `AttachmentHelper` has no v2 uploader); attachment *listing* is v2-aware like Java's `getContentAttachments`-backed lister.
- `_baseUrlV2` strips a trailing `/wiki` from the base path (no `/wiki/wiki`, Java #593).
- Echo server gained a `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint + v2 fixtures so tests assert exact request sequences against Java `ConfluenceApiV2Test` shapes.

### How to verify
```bash
dart test test/js/sync_tools/confluence_sync_tools_test.dart   # 35 tests
dart test test/integrations/confluence/confluence_api_v2_test.dart  # 30 tests
```

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  JS[executeToolViaJava] --> CST[ConfluenceSyncTools]
  CST -->|v2| V2["/wiki/api/v2/pages (POST/PUT/GET)"]
  CST -->|v2 + space key| SP["/wiki/api/v2/spaces?keys="]
  CST -->|v1 unchanged| V1["/wiki/rest/api/content…"]
  V2 --> PN[spaceIdFromKey + v2 payloads]
```
</details>

Review complete. **Verdict: APPROVE** (0 blocking, 1 important, 2 suggestions).

## Review summary — PR #357 (gh-346 Confluence REST v2 sync parity)

**What I did:**
- Read all input context (truncated diff recovered via `git diff origin/main...HEAD`)
- Full deep-read of all 4 changed lib files + both changed test files
- Compared sync implementation line-by-line against the async `ConfluenceClient`/`ConfluenceHttpClient` (the existing v2 reference) — payloads, URL shapes, `/wiki` normalization, error contracts all match
- Ran both claimed suites locally: **35/35 sync-tools + 30/30 v2 integration tests pass**; `dart analyze` clean

**Findings:**
1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT** (`confluence_sync_tools_helpers.dart:63`) — `_spaceIdFromKey` maps every failure (curl transport error, 401 from an under-scoped granular token) to "Confluence space not found by key", which will mislead users debugging v2 token setups. The async client surfaces the real HTTP error.
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION** (`confluence_sync_tools.dart:622`) — the v2 title-lookup unknown-space throw path (`confluence_content_by_title*` / `find_or_create`) is untested; only the `create_page` error envelope is covered.
3. 💡 **SUGGESTION** (`confluence_sync_page_ops.dart:59`) — duplicated `final version = _fetchVersion(contentId);` in both v1/v2 branches of `updatePage`; hoist above the branch.

Security, scope, and backward compatibility all check out: v1 paths untouched (all v2 branches gated on `_isApiV2`), credentials handling unchanged, CQL/multipart staying v1 is an explicitly documented Java limitation (#592), and the echo-server `REQUEST_LOG` endpoint correctly excludes `/__` meta-paths.
